terms.meaning: A tool that transforms CSS using plugins.
A plugin that adds browser-specific CSS prefixes automatically.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Style processing plugins
sections.what: Sets up Tailwind and Autoprefixer as the tools that process the styles.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed for Tailwind class names to become CSS.
sections.watch_out: Removing either plugin silently breaks styling.

summary: Tells the build step to run Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer on the styles.
purpose: Lets the Tailwind class names in the screens become real styles in the final CSS.
why: Likely reason: this is the standard setup for Tailwind.
how: Exports a list of two processing plugins that the Next.js build uses while it handles CSS.
inputs: CSS and Tailwind class names from the code.
outputs: Final CSS with browser prefixes added.
risks: Removing either plugin silently breaks styling.
debug: If styles are missing, check that this file still lists both plugins and that the build runs.
